column1: # release runs only for a push to main. chart and deploy run only after release
# reports released=true; an EMPTY released models a skipped release, which must
# skip both by needs-propagation. Row 2 is the loop guard: the release commit
# restarts CI, bump sees its tag on HEAD (or that main moved past the run's
# commit) and reports false, and nothing is published or deployed twice.
